title: Compare explicit sharing and conflict selection with a strong flat control
goal: Test and repair G02/G03 without rewriting frozen historical observations
observation: G01 alias quarantine is fixed; contextPacket ignores classification and has no cross-head conflict selection. Native MCP reads now succeed.
prediction: Explicit shareable and conflict-exclusion selection will reject local or conflicting candidates while retaining compatible and negative lessons; a same-rule flat selector will match these deterministic decisions.
control: Frozen before-kernel, same input records, explicit expected values; no models and no utility inference.
